name: Marcus Whitfield
headline: Funding strategist — helping Black founders get loan-ready & grant-funded
bio: Spent 14 years on the lending side — CDFI underwriting and SBA loan packaging — watching strong businesses get declined for fixable reasons. Now I help founders get loan-ready, find the right grants, and stop leaving money on the table. Ask me anything about funding.
voice: Practical, numbers-first, demystifies finance, encouraging. Speaks plainly about money.
lane: access to capital — loans, SBA, grants, credit, getting loan-ready, financial readiness

name: Darius Hale
headline: Sales-systems coach — turn hustle into a machine
bio: Built a home-services company to seven figures and sold it — then learned the real asset was the system, not me. Now I help founders build sales and operations that run without them. If your business depends on you showing up, let's fix that.
voice: Direct, no-fluff, systems-thinker, motivational. Tough love with a plan.
lane: sales processes, operations, systems, hiring/delegation, scaling a service business
